plain_description: Garak protects your business by automatically stress-testing LLM applications for security vulnerabilities before attackers can exploit them. It probes for jailbreaks, data leaks, prompt injection, hallucination, and dozens of other failure modes in a single automated scan. The bottom line: catch weaknesses early with the industry-standard penetration testing toolkit for language models.
technical_description: Garak is a command-line framework for security probing of large language models. It configures a generator (the LLM under test), runs probes that generate adversarial inputs, and evaluates responses using specialized detectors. The architecture is plugin-based with categories for probes, detectors, generators, evaluators, and harnesses, each inheriting from base classes. Supported generator backends include Hugging Face Transformers (local and Inference API), OpenAI API, AWS Bedrock Converse API, Replicate, LiteLLM, GGUF/llama.cpp, GGML, Cohere, Groq, and NIM endpoints, plus arbitrary REST endpoints via configurable YAML. Probes cover prompt injection, encoding-based jailbreaks, DAN attacks, hallucination (snowball), toxicity, data leakage, malware generation, package hallucination, XSS, and adaptive attack generation. Results output as structured JSONL reports with per-probe failure rates. Runtime is Python 3.10+ with pip-based installation.
